description: Turn a cadastral reference into a clear non-protected property fact sheet without confusing Catastro with title or planning permission.

defaultPrompt: Create a public property fact sheet from a cadastral reference.
Explain what cadastral data can and cannot prove about a property.
interface.longDescription:
Turn a cadastral reference into a clear non-protected property fact sheet without confusing Catastro with title or planning permission.

Includes a focused assistant workflow, official-source references, review examples and a Python 3.11+ read-only adapter. In ChatGPT, uses available native browsing/file tools; in Claude Code or Codex, the bundled scripts can retrieve official data directly when networking is permitted. No separate account, API key or publisher-hosted server is required for this skills release.

No protected owner information, tax identifiers, cadastral valuations, title certification, house valuation, parcel surveying or planning-permission verification.

Independent software by Sami Halawa. Not affiliated with Spanish public authorities.
